title: Strong formality below middle degree implies strong formality
summary: We show that hyperplane sections of strongly formal manifolds inherit strong formality. In particular, this property holds for generalized complete intersections defined by positive line bundles with trivial first de Rham cohomology group. Furthermore, we establish the strong formality of compact Kähler manifolds with central cohomology of width $\frac{n}{2}-1$ and, more generally, of compact $\partial\bar{\partial}$-manifolds with no non-trivial multiplicative relations in cohomology below degree $n+2$.
